purpose: Orthogonal release and source-provenance labels; no field alone is a data license or source-access grant.

public_release_status.description: Whether this artifact row is included in the public release package.

values.included_in_public_release: The normalized row is included in the public archive.

derived_artifact_status.description: How the released row relates to upstream material.

values.author_created_derived_post_extraction_c: Author-created structured evidence-card artifact derived after upstream extraction.
values.author_created_derived_forecast_trace: Author-created numerical forecast and decision-trace artifact.
values.author_created_release_manifest: Author-created inventory, integrity, and release-boundary metadata.
values.author_created_derived_replay_input: Author-created or normalized post-extraction input used by deterministic replay.

source_material_access_status.description: Whether underlying third-party source material is supplied with this package.

values.not_included_mixed_public_or_provider_ac: Underlying source documents are not included; original access conditions vary by source or provider.
values.not_required_for_public_post_extraction_: The deterministic public replay uses the released derived artifact and does not require the underlying source document.

source_material_redistribution_status.description: Whether this package redistributes or grants rights in underlying source material.

values.not_redistributed_no_rights_grant: Underlying third-party source material is not redistributed and no rights in it are granted.

verbatim_text_status.description: Whether third-party verbatim source text appears in the released artifact row.

values.withheld_hash_locator_only: Verbatim source text is withheld; only hashes, identifiers, lengths, or sentence locators may remain.
values.absent: The artifact contains no third-party verbatim source text.
values.withheld_or_absent_quote_free: Manifest-level profile covering quote-free inputs where source text is withheld or no text field exists.
